name: ubiquitin specific peptidase 8

function.text: USP8 encodes ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase 8. Annotated molecular activities include K48-linked deubiquitinase activity and K63-linked deubiquitinase activity. It participates in Ras protein signal transduction and endosome organization.
